findings.description: Pin/unpin operations for GPU memory with idempotent pin and error on unpin of non-pinned
findings.notes: Minor: unpin path only removes from HashSet without cudaHostUnregister. Semantically correct for IPC-opened device memory (inherently pinned by CUDA runtime), but spec language is slightly ambiguous about underlying unpin system call

findings.description: register_host_memory with cudaHostRegister + spdk_mem_register, rollback on partial failure. Now treats spdk_mem_register rc=-16 (EBUSY, already registered) as success.
findings.notes: rc=-16 occurs when memory-tier pool is allocated via spdk_zmalloc (already SPDK-registered). Treating as success is correct — no rollback needed. Actual SPDK failures (rc != 0 && rc != -16) still trigger cudaHostUnregister rollback per spec.
